summary: Example task runs show version on ERIC_ECCLI devices with eric_eccli_command.
questions: How do I run show version on ERIC_ECCLI devices?

answer_card.title: Run show version on ERIC_ECCLI
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: run show version on remote devices (eric_eccli)
  community.network.eric_eccli_command:
    commands: show version
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.eric_eccli'
```
